scope.field_dimension: one complex phi_1 fiber on the m=2 fixed-a slice
scope.finite_field_window: Phase-39 |y_phi|<=0.25 retained by an explicit C-infinity compact bend

checks.statement: T*exp(-kappa*delta)=rho*exp(-kappa*x), so the full-rate Starobinsky term is positive and psi-independent.
exp(kappa*x)*Re(S2) tends to (3/2)*pi^2*a^3*rho*exp(-2*kappa*phi)>0 uniformly for rho in [r,R] and psi in [-pi/2,pi/2].
At psi=plus-or-minus pi/2, Re(S2)/x tends to 4*pi^3*a^3/(kappa*rho)>0.
A central phase interval has a uniform positive quadratic bound and the endpoint intervals have a uniform positive linear bound.
The C-infinity curve equals the Phase-39 half-angle line throughout |y_phi|<=0.25 and equals the phase-locked affine tail outside a compact interval.
Re(delta)=x makes every fiber injective and immersed, while delta_{-psi}=conjugate(delta_psi).
On Re(delta)=0 the kinetic real part is nonpositive and the potential real part is bounded, so sufficiently high good regions cannot connect the two ends within the fixed scalar fiber.
The exhaustive prior case split has delta=q*y and does not include an affine intercept or a compactly bent contour.

exclusions: varying or complex a_1 and mixed a_1-phi_1 ends
r to zero, R to infinity, or a joint regulator-removal theorem
new connector intersections or a complete saddle/upward-cycle/sheet/end census
a Stokes chamber, determinant/Pfaffian/Pin orientation, or BFV body
a physical original cycle, signed global vector, physics claim, or TOE claim
authorization for a new runner, numbered phase, retry, or automatic descendant
